bridges.scope: True-preimage transport from total Boolean decision functions to binary languages preserves and reflects class equality and inequality.

bridges.missing_target: A pinned Programme-side Lean definition of the locked deterministic multitape machine, step cost, total decider, and polynomial simulation interface.

bridges.scope: Equivalence of the pinned imported natural-coefficient Polynomial Nat evaluation bound and the Programme eventual c*n^k presentation on the exact List Bool length measure, with all finite exceptional lengths explicitly absorbed. No machine-model or class equivalence is claimed.

bridges.missing_target: Programme-side formal verifier, self-delimiting pair encoding, witness bound, and the prerequisite machine-model bridge.
A selected concrete endpoint with formal parser, malformed-to-NO behavior, size measure, correctness theorem, and locked polynomial many-one reductions.

claim_boundary: This package proves only the Boolean-decision-function to binary-language carrier transport and the two-way polynomial-bound presentation conversion. It does not prove P equals NP, P differs from NP, either imported-to-Programme class equivalence, a Turing-machine simulation, an NP verifier equivalence, an endpoint theorem, novelty, or any MATHCERT disposition.
